---
title: "Home runs"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
hr_by_season <- Teams |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarise(
    home_runs_per_game = sum(HR) / sum(G),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    season_type = if_else(
      yearID %in% c(1918, 1919, 1981, 1994, 1995, 2020),
      "Shortened season",
      "Other season"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(hr_by_season, aes(x = yearID, y = home_runs_per_game)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(color = season_type)) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Other season" = "steelblue", "Shortened season" = "firebrick")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Major League Home Runs per Team-Game by Season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home runs per team-game",
    color = "Season type",
    caption = "Source: Lahman database"
  )
```

## Season comparison

```{r}
Teams |>
  filter(yearID %in% c(2019, 1981, 1994, 2020)) |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarise(
    total_home_runs = sum(HR),
    total_team_games = sum(G),
    home_runs_per_game = total_home_runs / total_team_games,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```
